theme: Settling before you know if you will win
title: Discovery or Settle: A Staged Litigation Policy
strategies: settle at the first offer (checker's own trivial reference construction)
commit globally to the better of the two non-adaptive extremes: settle immediately, or push every branch all the way to trial
backward-induction optimal-stopping policy: at every discovery node compare settling there against the discounted expected value of continuing, adapting the decision to each revealed branch
